summary.text: Scott Baldwin is a Republican who was elected in 2020 to Indiana Senate District 20.
He chairs the Insurance and Financial Institutions Committee and is a retired Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department officer.

paragraphs.text: According to his Indiana Senate Republican biography, Baldwin served in the United States Marine Corps and the United States Army Reserve.

He worked for the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department, where he supervised the Metropolitan Drug Task Force unit and the Homicide Unit, and received an IMPD Medal of Valor and two Medals of Bravery.
He also served as a Hamilton County Sheriff's Office reserve officer and worked for the Indiana Department of Correction.
He is the ranking member of the Tax and Fiscal Policy Committee and also serves on the Environmental Affairs Committee.

The page lists his current work with Envoy, Inc. (construction and real estate development) and Cloudapt, LLC (IT), and past service on the Hamilton County Redevelopment Commission and the Riverview Hospital board of trustees.
